model.title: Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Amendments Act of 2025
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Troy Downing (R-MT)

summary.text: The bill would amend a 2010 water rights settlement between the Crow Tribe and Montana by making several changes to how water infrastructure projects on the Crow Reservation are managed and funded. It would establish dedicated accounts to support the rehabilitation of the Crow Irrigation Project and the development of municipal, rural, and industrial water systems, and would extend the tribe's exclusive right to build hydropower facilities at a local dam by five years.
